## Summary

---

## Motivation

---

## Proposed Solution

Describe how you think the feature should work.

---

## Alternatives Considered

Have you considered another approach?

---

## Additional Context

Also, if your feature is based on a BitTorrent Enhancement Proposal (BEP), or the official protocol specification, linking the relevant document is greately appreciated.
